transcript:
Meeting Header
Date: 2027-12-02
Start Time: 16:00 UTC
Duration: 54 minutes
Attendees: Jordan Lee (Redwood CSM), Priya Patel (Redwood SE), Marcus Chen (Redwood AE), Lisa Carter (Maven Head of Data), Daniel Ortiz (Maven Platform Eng), Rhea Singh (Maven CTO)

Summary:
Quick kickoff to align onboarding milestones for Maven Health's Redwood deployment. Discussed hosted vs dedicated options, VPC/Private control plane, KMS and audit requirements, rollout plan, evaluation benchmarks, and next steps for security docs and pricing.

Topics Covered:
- Project goals and success criteria
- Infra requirements (VPC, egress, KMS)
- Data residency and compliance (SOC 2, audit logs)
- Dedicated vs Hosted tradeoffs (cost/latency)
- Onboarding timeline and milestones
- Benchmarks and POC plan

[00:00] Jordan Lee: Hey everyone, thanks for joining. I'm Jordan from Redwood, CSM on the account. Uh, quick intros and then we'll run through the plan.
[00:15] Marcus Chen: Hi all, Marcus AE here. Excited to get started.
[00:20] Lisa Carter: Hi, Lisa from Maven, thanks. We're looking to get proof points for latency and cost before full rollout.
[00:28] Priya Patel: Great. I'll be the SE working with Daniel on infra. We'll go over VPC and KMS details.
[00:35] Rhea Singh: Rhea here. High level goal is to add LLM features to our clinical search and notes summarization with strict PHI controls.

[01:05] Jordan Lee: Awesome. So goal for today is align on timeline, who owns what, and what we need for the first smoke test. We estimate 4 weeks for an initial pilot if infra lines up, can be faster for hosted only.
[01:30] Daniel Ortiz: Quick note — compliance team requires SOC 2 Type 2 and our security team wants audit logs retained for 3 years, and we use a KMS from our cloud provider.
[01:48] Priya Patel: That's fine. For Private deployments we support customer KMS integration and can route through private control plane, there's a short checklist. I'll send that.
[02:12] Lisa Carter: Are there any gotchas with data residency? We have a mix of EU and US tenants.
[02:25] Priya Patel: We can pin regions per-tenant and ensure data is routed to the correct region. For Private on-prem we'd keep everything in your network.

[03:00] Marcus Chen: On the commercial side, we sketched two paths: Hosted API for faster time-to-value, or Dedicated reserved capacity if you need predictable latency and capacity. We'll include a blended estimate in the deck.
[03:20] Rhea Singh: What about performance? We need sub-200ms token latency for query agents — is that realistic?
[03:30] Priya Patel: For short prompt sizes and caching, yes on Dedicated GPUs with optimized kernels we can hit low 100s. Hosted can be variable under load; we have SLAs on Dedicated. We'll run benchmarks during the pilot.

[04:10] Lisa Carter: Can you also speak to cost controls? We need to cap monthly spend and set rate limits per route.
[04:20] Jordan Lee: Yep, Console supports token-level cost dashboards, per-route quotas, and we can add pre-prod versus prod rate limits. We'll propose a reasonable default.

[05:00] Daniel Ortiz: Network-wise, what egress rules should we expect? Firewall, NAT?
[05:10] Priya Patel: For Hosted you'll need outbound egress to Redwood endpoints, we'll share IP ranges. For Private/VPC peering we'll provide a connector and a short list of ports.

[06:00] Rhea Singh: Security review — do you provide SOC 2 attestations and penetration test reports?
[06:10] Marcus Chen: Yes, we have SOC 2 and ISO docs; we'll share an ATO bundle and a redacted pentest summary.

[07:00] Jordan Lee: Next, pilot scope: 2 features — clinical search reranking and notes summarization. Success criteria: 5% improvement in relevance metrics for search, summary accuracy > 92% on sample evals, and latency under 200ms p50. Does that align?
[07:28] Lisa Carter: That works, though clinical team will validate the 92% number.

[08:05] Priya Patel: Technical plan: week 0 collect infra pre-reqs, week 1 deploy pilot infra (private connector), week 2 run sample evals and benchmarks, week 3 iterate and hand to product for UAT. If Hosted-only it's more like 2 weeks.
[08:30] Daniel Ortiz: For infra pre-reqs, I can get you network contacts and KMS admin, but we need your checklist.
[08:45] Priya Patel: I'll send a pre-req checklist after this call. It includes egress IPs, service account roles, and sample prompt sets.

[09:30] Speaker 1: Quick question on model variants, do you support quantized models for cost saving?
[09:40] Priya Patel: Yes, Redwood Optimize will recommend quantization profiles and we can run cost/perf analysis. For latency-sensitive routes we may avoid heavy quantization.

[10:15] Lisa Carter: Is there a way to preview logs and traces for each request? Our SREs want tracing hooks.
[10:25] Jordan Lee: Console has tracing and per-token latency breakdowns. We can enable more verbose logs for the pilot, with controlled retention.

[12:00] Rhea Singh: On data protection: can you guarantee no model training on customer data?
[12:08] Marcus Chen: Yes, we do not use customer payload for training; we can include that in the contract and show our data flow diagrams.

[13:00] Daniel Ortiz: For the private control plane, any OS or on-prem software requirements?
[13:12] Priya Patel: The on-prem package requires a small set of services (k8s v1.24+, container runtime). We'll include exact versions in the runbook.

[14:00] Lisa Carter: Ok, let's talk timelines. We were hoping for a Q1 production launch. Is that reasonable?
[14:10] Jordan Lee: Absolutely. If pilot starts mid-December, and depending on results, Q1 rollout is achievable. We'll map milestones and gating criteria.

[16:00] Priya Patel: I'll also propose a benchmark test harness and share a sample dataset and prompts. We usually run token-level profiling and end-to-end latency tests.

[18:00] Speaker 2: Who owns the eval metrics? We'll need a single source of truth.
[18:10] Jordan Lee: Typically joint ownership — Redwood runs the baseline benchmarks, Maven validates with your clinical team. We'll create a shared spreadsheet for results.

[20:00] Lisa Carter: Any blockers on our side right now? I need to confirm resources.
[20:12] Daniel Ortiz: I'll need to loop in networking and security; ETA for contacts is tomorrow.

[22:00] Rhea Singh: Are there sample SLAs for Dedicated?
[22:10] Marcus Chen: Yes, we'll share SLA table in the commercial packet — uptime, p50/p95 latency targets, and credit policy.

[25:00] Priya Patel: One more technical thing — for reranking we recommend using our embeddings route plus a small generation model for context. We'll provide guidance on prompt engineering.

[28:00] Lisa Carter: We'll want to run a side-by-side against our current Lucene-based relevancy to verify improvements.
[28:10] Jordan Lee: Perfect, include the query log and we'll setup the eval harness.

[31:00] Daniel Ortiz: For the KMS integration, any constraints on key rotation?
[31:10] Priya Patel: We support customer-managed keys with standard rotation; we'll document the lifecycle.

[34:00] Jordan Lee: Alright, let's recap next steps. Marcus to send pricing options and PO template. Priya sends infra checklist + schedule for workshop. Jordan sends onboarding plan, milestone Gantt and shared eval sheet. Daniel to provide network/security contacts.

[36:00] Lisa Carter: When can we expect the docs?
[36:08] Jordan Lee: I'll get the onboarding plan and runbook to you by Monday 2027-12-06. Marcus by 2027-12-07 with pricing. Priya will propose workshop times for 2027-12-08.

[38:00] Rhea Singh: One final concern — do you have an escalation path for incidents during pilot?
[38:08] Marcus Chen: Yes, we'll include a 24/7 primary and a technical escalation path in the runbook with names and SLAs for Dedicated customers.

[40:00] Speaker 3: Do you integrate with our SSO via SAML?
[40:08] Priya Patel: Yes, SSO/SAML and SCIM provisioning supported for Console. We'll need metadata file from your IdP.

[43:00] Jordan Lee: Any other questions?
[43:10] Lisa Carter: Not right now, thanks. Feels like good alignment.

[45:00] Priya Patel: I'll follow up with the infra checklist and the connector docs. Expect links to sample configs.
[46:00] Marcus Chen: I'll send the commercial packet, and we'll set up a follow-up for the VPC workshop.

[48:00] Jordan Lee: Thanks everyone. We'll capture action items and follow up.

[52:00] Rhea Singh: Thanks, talk soon.
[52:10] Jordan Lee: Thanks, bye.

Action Items (captured in call):
- Jordan: Send onboarding plan + Gantt, shared eval spreadsheet (due 2027-12-06)
- Priya: Infra pre-req checklist, IP ranges, connector docs, schedule VPC workshop (due 2027-12-08)
- Marcus: Pricing options, Dedicated proposal, SLA table (due 2027-12-07)
- Daniel: Provide network/security contacts and firewall rules (due 2027-12-06)

Links referenced: onboarding runbook (link shared post-call), SOC 2 attestation (doc link), sample benchmark harness (link), commercial packet (link to be sent).

End of transcript.
